scope: English standard releases only; sustained integrated Fabric client observation, sequential switches in one game session
measurement: Sum of Windows working sets for llama-server.exe descendants of the tested Minecraft JVM. Lifetime PeakWorkingSet also captured. JVM measured separately. Card uses the higher native sampled/lifetime peak, rounded upward to 0.1 GiB.
limitations: One machine and one configuration; no guarantee for other context sizes, runtimes, languages or GPU offload.
Finite observation, not a long-term leak proof or a comprehensive dialogue-quality grade.
JVM baseline and later JVM sizes include ordinary game allocation/GC variation; do not treat their difference as native model RAM.
Unfiltered training and releases were not tested or changed.
switch_bug: MiniCPM5→LFM3 initially exposed reentrant cancellation during AiChatService.disable. Fixed by detaching pending futures before cancelling. Direct/event callback regression passed. Short ordered replay after rebuild verifies switching with in-flight inference. Full LFM3 and return-to-Legacy observations are from the repaired build.
